notes.title: 4th content update released
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce the release of a new content update for Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex.

This update continues the storyline from the previous update. There are new locations, new characters, new scenes, and a slightly modified gallery. A few sound effects have been added to earlier scenes. 

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, typos, or continuity errors. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Content Update Released (3rd)
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex.

This update continues the storyline from the previous update. There are four new adult scenes in total - three of them are located within the new story content, and one is an addition to previous content. Some scenes are only available if certain past choices were made.

Without specific spoilers, I received some feedback about an earlier scene, specifically not liking the addition of a second male character in a scene, so I have included an additional option to that scene. You can see which scene I am referring to in the replay gallery.

Since the cast of characters is increasing I have included a disclaimer at the beginning of the game if you happen to pick a name associated with an existing character. It's new code that I've mostly tested but please advise if it causes any issues.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Second Content Update Released
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex.

This update continues the storyline and mostly contains existing characters and settings (though there may be a surprise guest showing up depending on earlier choices). The choices that are made will have an impact in this update and you won't be able to see all the scenes in a single playthrough, unless you rollback of course. This update may seem shorter or longer to some people due to this.

There's a couple of stats that I'm still trying to balance, and am considering adding new ones, so be sure to leave feedback if anything feels too easy or hard to achieve. Also there's a large number of variables to keep track of so hopefully I've made the correct conditionals, but if anything doesn't seem to make sense let me know so I can fix it.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Content Update Released
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce the release of a new content update for Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex. The update continues the story where it left off, and introduces a number of new characters and settings. 

While this update does contain several new adult scenes and achievements, some people may feel there is less of a focus on erotic elements this update. I wanted to properly introduce the new characters and environment firstly before focusing on that aspect of it. Rest assured that the next update will have a stronger focus on adult situations.

If I have tested it correctly then your existing save games should work, and if you've saved your game during the ending credits then it should revert back to the last scene, after which the game should continue as per normal. If there's any issues, let me know, but the game is still in Early Access so you may have to load an earlier save.

Let me know if there are any bugs, issues, or typos. Also leave any feedback as necessary. That's all I have for now. Enjoy.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Upcoming release information
notes.notes:
Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex is scheduled to release into Early Access in a little over a week. The Early Access build has been uploaded and approved, which means the planned release date should be met.

The story has been continued from the demo, with much more dialogue, scenes, and animations. Additionally, the dialogue from the demo has been changed, and there is an additional animation. If you played the demo, I recommend starting again due to the changed dialogue, the additional animation, and the ability to get the achievements. This means the demo has been deactivated as it no longer accurately represents the state of the project.

As this game will be released as Early Access, there will be added content provided in the form of updates over the coming months. It also means that some content is subject to change depending on feedback. As I have previously mentioned, I have been adding screenshots showing snippets of the added content, so have a look if you're interested.

That's all I have for now. Thanks.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Next Fest and development update
notes.notes:
This is just a quick note to advise that Surviving the Apocalypse Is More Fun When There’s Sex will be appearing in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. This is the first Next Fest one of my games will be participating in so I'm not sure what to expect but I hope to see some good results.

Development of the game is continuing along, and I have been periodically adding additional screenshots to the store page so if you haven't looked in a while check it out. It will show images that aren't in the current demo version.

That's all I have for now.

JellyFluff
